errata.why: FORGE section 4.2, structural result: a quota binds only if you can name principals and prevent free creation of principals. Under stdio local-first there is exactly ONE OS principal (client and server are the same user), session creation is free by design (each turn, each reconnect, each server process), and even a server-signed token does not help because the server would issue one to whoever asks. So no per-subject quota can bind in v1 without changing the deployment posture, which docs/02 defers. The bound must therefore move from the SUBJECT to the OBJECT: per engram, per wall-clock window - keyed on what a caller cannot mint. FORGE section 4.3: 'Under local-first stdio, Magicite's achievable integrity guarantee is temporal, not authenticational.' These object-keyed bounds are not v1 stopgaps: they survive into the deferred served profile, composing with per-tenant authorization rather than being replaced by it. A security claim a reader relies on and that does not hold is worse than an absent one.

errata.trigger: ATLAS confirmed BY EXECUTION that author-declared edges (needs->depends_on, composes, inhibits) carry exactly zero activation mass, permanently, and that no code path can ever raise them: route() at spec defaults and route() with every declared type_gain AND inhib_gain zeroed return BIT-IDENTICAL scores to 12 decimal places, while forcing a declared S_edge=0.9 does change the ranking - the path is live, it is never fed. Mechanism: storage/durable.py:203 inserts declared edges at storage_strength=0.0 and the ON CONFLICT clause updates only dst_id/dangling so re-sync never raises it; core/dream.py:194 + core/signals.py:152-164 mean Dream can only potentiate co_activation, the sole type ever tagged; core/activation.py:56 then DROPS edges with w<=0, so declared edges are ABSENT from the graph rather than weak.
errata.why_this_is_a_spec_defect_not_a_bug: spec.md:593 section 3.3 step 10 derives plan_confidence from S_edge over plan edges. Plan edge types are depends_on/composes, always provenance='declared', and Dream potentiates only co_activation - so mean(S_edge) is a STRUCTURAL constant and plan_confidence is permanently 0.0 for every multi-node plan. It is client-visible (core/router.py:378,395 -> mcp/schemas.py:150 -> mcp/bind_retrieval.py:66). The spec asked for something unsatisfiable as written; no patch can fix that without a spec decision. Secondarily, apply_inhibition (core/activation.py:144-167) is a numeric no-op (a_i *= 1 - 0.0*0.7 = 1), so AC-023 is UNREACHABLE IN PRODUCTION - it passes only because tests/unit/core/test_router.py:80 injects storage_strength=0.8 by direct SQL.
errata.counter_argument_engaged: storage/durable.py:304-309 documents the 0.0 as deliberate - 'a declared edge encodes intent and must still be learned (Dream, M4) before it carries weight ... weight is earned, not assumed'. That is a coherent design position and it is NOT dismissed: the amendment preserves it verbatim for the channel it was always about (edge.storage_strength, the Hebbian channel, still starts at 0.0 for a declared edge and is still Dream-only). What it is not is a defence of the current state: the mechanism by which a declared edge would EARN weight was never built, and M4 has shipped. The strongest evidence for oversight over intent is that the codebase diagnosed this same failure mode THREE times and worked around it locally each time - core/registry.py:60-71 (_COMMUNITY_WEIGHT_FLOOR=0.1), core/router.py:14-25 (structural hub PageRank), eval/bench.py:70-78 (baseline (c)) - all sharing the premise 'inert UNTIL Dream/M4 exists', while nobody patched the three places where the same zero is load-bearing.
errata.what_changed: spec.md gains a new normative subsection 3.3.1 'Effective edge weight': S_eff(edge) = max(edge.storage_strength, w_authored(edge)), where w_authored = declared_edge_strength (new magicite.toml knob, default 1.0) for provenance='declared' and 0.0 for learned/derived/distilled. Computed at READ, never stored - no column, no second migration, no checkpoint field - so AC-009/AC-010 are untouched (pinned by new AC-036) and Dream's decay/prune/renormalise still operate on the learned column alone. Floor, not replacement: learning may exceed an assertion, it may not erase one. Range-preserving (S_eff in [0,1]) so 1 - S*inhib_gain stays positive. Exactly revertible at declared_edge_strength=0.0 (new AC-039). One pure helper core/edge_weight.py::effective_strength, guarded by a new AST criterion (AC-040). Amended call sites: section 3.3 step 4 (W_ij = S_eff * type_gain), step 5 (a_i *= 1 - S_eff*inhib_gain, S_eff DIRECTLY since type_gain['inhibits']=0.0 by design), step 9 (cycle-break becomes a total order (S_eff, dep_name, dependent_name) - it previously degenerated to dict iteration order because everything tied at 0.0), step 10 (plan_confidence redefined structurally), section 2.6 step 9 (community weights: S_eff replaces max(S_edge,0.1); _COMMUNITY_WEIGHT_FLOOR deleted), introspect edge rows (additive effective_strength field), eval/bench.py baseline (c) (same helper with the learned channel suppressed). DELIBERATELY NOT changed: the hub-penalty structural PageRank (measured to help, +0.0286 Hit@1; whether it should be learned-topology-weighted is an open experiment), Dream's phases, wire_declared_edges, the DDL, and the 16-tool surface.
errata.plan_confidence_fix: section 3.3 step 10 WAS mean(S_edge over plan edges) * (resolved_deps/declared_deps), which was unsatisfiable. NOW plan_confidence = |E_sat|/|E| (1.0 when |E|==0), where E is every declared depends_on/composes edge whose src is a node in the emitted plan (dangling INCLUDED) and E_sat are those that resolve, whose target appears in `order`, and whose ordering `order` respects. The S_edge factor is REMOVED rather than floated to 1.0: it can only ever be a constant under any future in which Dream's tagging is unchanged, so it carries no information in either regime. All three ways a plan is actually untrustworthy fall out of one rule with no extra constants - dangling target fails clause 1, depth/size-cut target fails clause 2, cycle-broken edge fails clause 3. Deliberate behaviour change: the len(order)<=1 -> 1.0 short-circuit is gone, so a lone winner with two unresolvable needs now reports 0.0 - the honest answer, and exactly the case the short-circuit hid. Pinned by AC-037/AC-038.
default_changes: ppr_restart 0.15 -> 0.85. MEASURED (70 engrams / 210 pre-registered queries, one Config field at a time, arm-invariant): Hit@1 0.4619 -> 0.5476 (identical to embedding baseline (b)'s 0.5476), Hit@3 0.7000 -> 0.7476 (ABOVE (b)'s 0.7429), MRR 0.5913 -> 0.6398. At 0.15, 85% of activation mass diffused along the 350 derived similar_to kNN edges and the PPR term contributed 37% as much ranking spread as similarity - spread reflecting neighbourhood mass, not query match. WHY NOT w_activation=0, which measures 0.0048 Hit@1 better (0.5524): inhibition acts ONLY on the activation vector, so zeroing that weight makes AC-023 arithmetically UNPROVABLE - you would break a frozen criterion to buy one query in 210 - and it would turn 45% of the score into a constant zero, taking the hub penalty and community rerank with it.

w_retrieval 0.15 -> 0.05 and w_similarity 0.30 -> 0.40, labelled PRECAUTIONARY PENDING FURTHER EXPERIMENT and NOT a measured optimum. The justification is an evidence-balance asymmetry, not a new magic number: 0.15 has ONE strong measurement against it (under an oracle teacher on a MATCHED train/test distribution, held-out Hit@1 fell 0.4697 -> 0.1061, a 3.6x collapse; it degrades on its own training split too, 0.4583 -> 0.2847; the target-only variant with zero learned edges still collapses to 0.1818) and ZERO measurements ever FOR it. Mechanism measured: w_similarity*cosine spread 0.0561 vs w_retrieval*R spread 0.0354 = 63% of the query-conditioned signal's amplitude, contributed by a pure usage-frequency prior with zero query conditioning. Honest limit carried: the workload is uniform, which makes a popularity prior maximally uninformative. w_activation (0.45) and w_excitability (0.10) unchanged; the four still sum to 1.00. Reverse on evidence if component normalisation recovers cold-level held-out Hit@1 at 0.15.

errata.ruling_vs_forge: ADOPTED on substance, SHARPENED on mechanism, with one site withheld. Adopted: declared mutual exclusion and composition are AUTHORED ASSERTIONS, not earned Hebbian weights. Sharpened: (1) the category error was the CONFLATION of two semantics in one column, not the 'earned' principle itself - so the amendment keeps 'weight is earned' true of S_edge and adds a named authored channel rather than declaring the principle wrong; (2) a FLOOR, max(S_edge, w_authored), not FORGE's 'fixed gain independent of S_edge' - learning may exceed an assertion, it may not erase one, and this also keeps S_eff in [0,1] so 1 - S*inhib_gain stays positive; (3) scope is all authored edge types, not just inhibits, since fixing inhibition alone would leave composes/depends_on dropped from the graph and plan_confidence at 0.0. FORGE's arithmetic objection to a floor is ANSWERED rather than accepted: it is an objection to the magnitude 0.1 (inherited from _COMMUNITY_WEIGHT_FLOOR, ~2.7% of graph mass), not to the form - at the authored magnitude 1.0 the same arithmetic gives ~21.7% of global mass and, since W is row-normalised, ~36-53% of a declared node's own outflow. WITHHELD: the hub-penalty structural PageRank keeps type_gain-only weighting; it is the one graph mechanism measured to help (+0.0286 Hit@1, +0.0362 MRR) and whether it should be learned-topology-weighted is FORGE's own open D3 experiment - consistency is not worth an unmeasured change to a measured-good component. REJECTED alternative (preserve 'earned' and make declared edges EARNABLE instead): there is no observable whose accumulation makes 'A inhibits B' more true (co-activation is evidence AGAINST it); it leaves every freshly-authored registry routing as if the author had declared nothing; and it is strictly larger work. The earnable path is NOT closed - the floor form already lets a potentiated declared edge win - it is deferred as CF-3.
